checks.check: **Two faces, by role.** A monospace face carries labels, keys, kickers, readouts and captions; a proportional sans face carries titles, ledes and paragraphs. Look at the paragraphs first, then at the small uppercase labels.
checks.fails_when: a paragraph or a lede is set in the monospace face, a small uppercase label is set in the proportional face, or a third face (a serif, a display face, a second sans) appears between the rails
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **Gold is wayfinding, and it is counted.** Count the gold objects. Each should have a job: what is lit, what is picked, what is open, what to press, what a kicker names. Twelve at most.
checks.fails_when: more than twelve gold objects, or a structural rule, seam or box outline is drawn in gold, the console's lip and the flashcards' lip (the folder device, ADR-097) excepted
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **No hue outside the tiers.** Neutral ground, neutral ink, gold, the provenance green. Photographs are taken into the duotone.
checks.fails_when: a third hue, a cool tint, a purple or blue, or a photograph in its own colour
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **The ground is the theme's.** A void subject is dawn ink on a near-black ground; a parchment subject is dark ink on parchment. Judged from the candidate alone.
checks.fails_when: the ground contradicts the subject named in the caption, or two grounds meet with a hard step
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **Flat material.** One ground, one step for a plate. No gradient as decoration, no bloom, no glow, no drop shadow.
checks.fails_when: a ramp, a halo, a glow or a shadow is doing the work a line should do
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **The corner law.** Zero radius anywhere between the rails. The console's panel and the flashcards carry the top-right and bottom-left chamfer; their children are square; marks are diamonds, never circles. The frame's round navigation button at the bottom-left is chrome, not a mark.
checks.fails_when: any rounded corner between the rails, a chamfer on the wrong diagonal, a chamfered child inside a chamfered box, or a circular mark on the page itself
checks.block: A. The register. Any failure here stops the still.

checks.check: **The page divides itself with seams, and panels are seated on them.** A hairline seam between sections, the head band's rule under every kicker, and no vertical rule of the page's own: the frame's two rails are its only verticals (owner, 2026-09-20).
checks.fails_when: a section has no seam above it, a panel or a cell edge floats with no rule behind it, a rule stops short of the band with nothing to stop it, or the page draws a full-height vertical of its own

checks.check: **Cells share edges.** Where a section is divided, the divisions are one hairline apiece and the cells meet on it. No gutter grid, no doubled line, no boxes in boxes.
checks.fails_when: two cells are separated by air, a line is drawn twice a pixel apart, or a box sits inside a cell

checks.check: **One line weight, one hue, three alphas.** Every structural line is the neutral ink at one pixel; only its alpha ranks it. The only dashed line is the two-up divider.
checks.fails_when: a second weight, a second hue on structure, more than three distinguishable alphas, or a dashed rule elsewhere

checks.check: **The head is composed on the rules, never centred.** A name kicker and a sentence-case display title on one side, the paragraphs on the other, and no hero image anywhere.
checks.fails_when: the title is centred, a hero image or a full-bleed picture opens the page, or the head fills a whole viewport

checks.check: **Every section opens on a head band**: a mono kicker, an ordinal where the knob is on, one hairline under both.
checks.fails_when: a section has no kicker, the ordinal is missing where the knob is on or present where it is off, or the band has no rule

checks.check: **A timeline plots a record.** The mornings sit on a dated axis at their dates or on a vertical date rail; exactly one node is lit; past ones are dim. On the sessions page only.
checks.fails_when: the items are evenly spread regardless of date, none or more than one is lit, or a past item reads as live

checks.check: **Ruled rows align and one step is open.** In rows and steps, the fields align down the column on one hairline per row; in a steps section exactly one item is elaborated.
checks.fails_when: fields wander between rows, a row has no rule, or none or more than one step is open

checks.check: **Figures are framed.** A figure carries a bracketed FIG caption bar above and a mono caption below; a two-up sits on a dashed divider; photographs are in the duotone.
checks.fails_when: a picture is dropped on the page bare, a two-up has no divider, or a photograph shows its own colour

checks.check: **Split the slack, and one first read.** Vertical surplus is shared, never pooled under one block; from across the room one thing leads.
checks.fails_when: a block sits high over a hole, or nothing leads and three things lead together

checks.check: **Nothing above the weight ceiling.** Emphasis is ink and size, never bold; the monospace face is never bold.
checks.fails_when: a label, a row, a key or a claim is set bolder than its neighbours, or any monospace text is bold

checks.check: **Case ranks.** The sans is sentence case; only the monospace chrome is uppercase.
checks.fails_when: a sans title or sentence is shouted, or everything is uppercase so case says nothing

checks.check: **Labels of one rank share one rung.** Kickers track alike, readout labels track alike, captions track alike.
checks.fails_when: two labels at the same rank are visibly differently tracked

checks.check: **Nothing is under the floor, and chrome sits at the extremes.** Every string reads at the still's own scale; chrome at the top and the bottom.
checks.fails_when: any string is too small to read, or chrome sits in the middle of a section

checks.check: **Three registers on a card.** A flashcard reads kicker, title, paragraph in that order and the claim is never in the monospace face.
checks.fails_when: a card has two registers, the kicker carries the claim, or the title is set in the monospace face

checks.check: **The console's head bar is fused to the housing** with a designation at each end: the name left, a slashed kicker right.
checks.fails_when: the bar floats inside the panel with air on every side, or it carries one designation

checks.check: **The readout column is a record.** Labels dim, values lit, every value something a reader could check against the site: a count, a standing, a chip, a year, a list of kinds.
checks.fails_when: a label and a value share one weight of ink, a value is empty, or a value is a claim rather than a fact

checks.check: **Selection is elaboration, never fill or hue.** The picked station is the one filled thing in its row; the open step grows lines; the lit node grows a filled diamond; nothing else changes colour.
checks.fails_when: selection is signalled by a colour swap alone, more than one thing in a row is filled, or the open item is the same size as the rest

checks.check: **The flashcards are a pile on the sheet.** Kicker and title at the top, the duotone figure in the middle, the paragraph at the bottom; the front card whole and the ones behind it peeking by their heads. Where card=grid, a static two-column grid with the same three registers.
checks.fails_when: a card shows its figure at the top, the front card is cut, the pile reads as a gallery grid where card=stack, or the grid has gutters wider than a hairline where card=grid

checks.check: **The variety law is read on the sheet.** Across a page's stills no two consecutive sections share an arrangement, no arrangement appears more than twice, at least three appear, and figures change side.
checks.fails_when: two consecutive stills show the same arrangement, one arrangement carries the page, or every figure sits on one side

checks.check: **One grammar across the set.** The six pages, both themes and both viewports read as one instrument; the light stills re-derive rather than inherit; no page reproduces a reference beat for beat.
checks.fails_when: a page reads as a different site, a light still is a dark one washed out, or a page is a reference site with the copy replaced

checks.check: **Each direction differs on the axis it claims, and no other.** SD stacks the head and drops the ordinals; SE grids the cards and rails the timeline.
checks.fails_when: two directions' stills are indistinguishable, or one moves an axis it did not claim

checks.check: **Every arrangement and every state once, captioned, and the fixtures labelled as fixtures.** On the specimen sheet only.
checks.fails_when: an arrangement is missing, a state (lit, open, picked, draft) is missing, or a fixture reads as a claim

checks.check: **The specimens share one grammar.** The kit's sections read as one sheet, not a collection of components.
checks.fails_when: two specimens contradict each other on a rule the other sections share

set_level: set: 6 image types present (AC, AR, HS, MP, MU, SK); the difference table is audited at generation time
